About Citi:
Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.
As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.
Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.
The Role:
The Senior Program Manager, Cybersecurity & Technology Risk is a strategic program leadership role accountable for driving the planning, governance, execution, and delivery of Citi's enterprise-wide Post Quantum Readiness Program. This individual will build and maintain the multi-year program plan, coordinate across Cyber, Technology, Infrastructure, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Business stakeholders, and manage critical dependencies with external vendors whose quantum roadmaps directly affect Citi's migration timeline. The role carries significant external visibility, including regular engagement with regulators such as the OCC, FRB, FDIC, FCA, Hong Kong Monetary Authority, and Monetary Authority of Singapore. Success in this position requires translating complex technical and cryptographic concepts into executive-ready governance reporting, risk assessments, and actionable roadmaps. This is a highly visible, cross-functional role that directly supports Citi's security posture, operational resilience, and regulatory standing as the organization accelerates its mobilization for Post Quantum migration.
Responsibilities
Build and maintain the PQC Readiness multi-year program plan, including workstreams, migration phases and waves, milestones, critical path identification, and dependencies on vendors, platforms, and standards.
Develop and communicate a risk-based, data-driven governance strategy for the Quantum Readiness Program in partnership with architecture, engineering, operations, and information security stakeholders. Maintain integrated roadmaps, execution strategies, and operating frameworks to support successful delivery.
Run the program's operating process, including working group cadence, meeting management, and minutes circulation. Track decisions and escalation paths, and prepare materials for Senior and Executive Management reporting.
Produce and maintain the single source of truth for program status, with consistent reporting on KPIs, KRIs, and critical success criteria for governance, leadership, internal audit, and regulators.
Turn prioritized PQ readiness assessments into dated commitments from application and infrastructure owners. Track delivery against roadmaps and escalate issues and delays.
Align sequencing across shared infrastructure and platforms, such as PKI, HSM (Hardware Security Module), and KMS (Key Management Services), so downstream teams are prepared. Proactively coordinate stakeholders, follow up on action items, and remove blockers.
Track critical vendor PQC roadmaps and delivery dates using tools including Confluence and Jira. Fold vendor roadmap updates into program planning and escalate issues and delays.
Coordinate activities across multiple projects and workstreams while managing competing priorities and resource constraints. Manage internal deadlines, deliverables, and planning for dependent work efforts.
Engage regularly with internal teams and external parties to identify Quantum Readiness roadmap deficiencies and communicate impacts to overall program health. Respond to the increasing frequency of internal and external regulatory requests on program readiness and alignment.
Facilitate the implementation of approved cyber security tools and identify new or improved security solutions or emerging technologies. Communicate changes to cyber security regulations and standards with business and program owners.
Develop Corrective Action Plans for remediation gaps and monitored issues through to completion. Plan communications and training so teams understand what is required of them, when, and where to get help.
Build internal relationships and drive program-level timelines and requirements across the Enterprise and globally.
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, with particular consideration for the firm's reputation. Drive compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, and apply sound ethical judgment regarding personal conduct. Escalate, manage, and report control issues with transparency, and effectively supervise the activity of others, creating accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.
Qualifications
6+ years' experience managing technology programs and/or large projects within highly regulated, enterprise and global environments.
Technical PM experience within cybersecurity is highly preferred.
Solid understanding of technologies where cryptography is applied, such as software, networking, identity systems, and data platforms.
Understanding of cryptography, algorithms, and implementations, maintained and enhanced through ongoing research, self-study, and engagement.
Enterprise and solution-oriented architectural experience.
Ability to leverage Citi generative AI tools to accelerate data analysis and automate presentation creation, transforming complex datasets into polished, management-ready visual narratives.
Strong verbal and written communication, diplomacy, and influencing skills are required.
Experience negotiating with external parties, including suppliers and vendors, is a plus.
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent relevant experience.
Master's degree preferred.
Relevant industry certifications like CAPM, PMP, PgMP, etc. are a plus.

About the Opportunity:
Are you a talented Public Cloud Network – Security Engineer looking for their next challenge? Do you have a passion for building cutting-edge enterprise products and a hands-on approach to engineering? Join Citi's Cloud Technology Services (CTS) team and be part of our commitment to transform Citi technology, leveraging game-changing Cloud capabilities to drive agility, efficiency, and innovation.
We are providing our businesses with a competitive edge by leveraging public cloud scale and enabling new infrastructure economics As an Network Security Engineer within the Network Infrastructure Team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing our public cloud strategy.
You will be part of a Public Cloud team that continues to deliver big by designing and managing the platform that enables the automated deployment of foundational resources globally across multiple public clouds. This foundation enables the business to deploy critical workloads, from building a cloud base High Performance Compute (HPC) platform to run huge risk calculations, enabling Citi to leverage GenAI at scale, all the way to enabling payment solutions, this team is at the forefront of innovation.
Role Description:
The role of Public Cloud Network – Security Engineer will be instrumental in ensuring Citi public cloud resources deployed in GCP and AWS are secured using industry standard tools and best practices. You will be responsible for designing, certifying, deploying and managing the security network infrastructure resources within GCP and AWS that secure all traffic flows between resource in the cloud and on-premises. The role requires an engineer with expert technical skills and the ability to collaborate with stakeholders and partners throughout the full resource provisioning life cycle, from inception and design, to deployment, operational management and iterative refinement.
You will have a voice within the team to influence strategic decisions, contribute to the creation of roadmaps and engage with key technology and business stakeholders.
The Network Infrastructure Team is based in multiple locations across the globe and comprises of Architects, Cloud Engineers and Security Engineers.
What you’ll do:
Technical Expertise: design and build highly resilient and scalable security solutions that support the business requirements as part of the organisations public cloud strategy.
Engineering Excellence: follow engineering best practices and industry standards using modern tooling that enables CI/CD and favours automation, auditability, automated testing, infrastructure and policy as code.
Collaborative Development: work with a talented team of cloud engineers across the wider Public Cloud team who are responsible for Network, Project / Account Provisioning, Platform, Data, Pipelines, and Operations. You will also work closely with the business functions who are creating / migrating service and applications to the cloud environment.
Innovate and Automate: identify and develop automated solutions as part of continual improvement to reduce the time to market of cloud services, enhancing client satisfaction and delivering business value.
Compliance Advocacy: ensure adherence to relevant standards, policies, and regulations, prioritizing the protection of Citi's reputation, clients, and assets.
What we’ll need from you:
5+ years of relevant experience in an Engineering role
You are a talented and experienced Network Security Engineer with a proven track record of infrastructure design, testing and automated deployment via Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
You will have a expert level understanding of public cloud network security infrastructure services available in GCP and AWS.
Proven ability to implement network segmentation strategies effectively using cloud native services and resources.
Ability to work independently, multi-task, and take ownership of various parts of a project or initiative.
Ability to adapt quickly to changing threat landscapes and business requirements.
Hands-on experience developing and engineering software solutions and services, with a focus on cloud-native applications
Understanding of cloud security best practices and compliance frameworks.
Knowledge of container security and orchestration tools such as Kubernetes.
Extensive experience with CI/CD methodologies and tools.
Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployment using Terraform.
Proficiency in Python, Golang, AWS/GCP SDKs

Master’s degree preferred

Citi’s Banking Technology organization is seeking a highly hands-on Senior AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy cutting‑edge AI solutions for Investment, Corporate, and Commercial Banking.
This role focuses on implementing scalable, agentic AI frameworks and generative AI solutions within small, agile squads. The successful candidate will operate with an AI‑first mindset , emphasizing rapid prototyping, MVP‑driven development, and iterative delivery of production‑grade AI capabilities.
Key Responsibilities:
AI Solution Development: Design, implement, and deploy scalable agentic AI frameworks and generative AI solutions for critical business use cases, ensuring robustness, performance, security, and reliability.
Agentic Systems: Develop and integrate agentic AI systems leveraging multiple model providers and platforms (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google APIs).
Full‑Stack AI Engineering: Build full‑stack applications integrating LLM‑driven workflows and AI coding tools (e.g., Devin, GitHub Copilot).
Iterative Delivery: Drive an MVP‑first, rapid‑iteration approach with continuous experimentation and improvement.
Evaluation & Optimization: Define and implement metrics, evaluation strategies, and feedback loops to continuously improve AI system performance and behavior.
Emerging Technologies: Research, prototype, and integrate advances in agent‑based, autonomous, and generative AI technologies.
Technical Collaboration: Contribute hands‑on within cross‑functional teams and provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
Domain Alignment: Ensure AI solutions are well‑aligned to banking and financial services requirements, constraints, and business outcomes.
Qualifications:
Programming: Strong proficiency in Python and/or Java (Spring Boot); working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript (Angular, Node.js). Full‑stack experience is a plus.

Solid understanding of core AI concepts such as knowledge representation, planning, and multi‑agent systems.

Practical experience with ML frameworks and libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit‑learn, NumPy, Pandas).

Platforms: Hands‑on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.
Problem Solving & Communication: Strong analytical skills with the ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts.
Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of banking/financial services and regulated environments.
Nice to Have: Experience in data science (statistical modeling, experimentation) and interest in mentoring junior AI engineers.
Experience:
6–10 years of progressive software engineering experience with a strong hands‑on coding background.
2+ years focused on AI software development, LLM‑based solutions, agentic systems, and/or machine learning.
Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise‑scale AI capabilities into production.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Robotics, or a related quantitative discipline.

The USCC Architecture and AI Engineering group is seeking a seasoned and visionary prinicipal Generative AI/AI Lead to guide our team and architect the next generation of intelligent systems. This is a pivotal role in driving our AI project execution, from conceptualization through to production. We are looking for an expert with a proven track record in designing and delivering robust, scalable, and well-governed AI solutions. The ideal candidate will be a technical leader who can mentor a talented team of engineers, collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, and steer our technical direction in the rapidly evolving landscape of Generative and Agentic AI.
Key Responsibilities
Architect & Design: Lead the design and architecture of complex, end-to-end AI systems, ensuring they are scalable, resilient, maintainable, and secure.
Strategize & Collaborate: Partner directly with business leaders and product managers to identify high-impact AI opportunities, define project roadmaps, and translate strategic business needs into a coherent technical vision.
Lead & Mentor: Manage, mentor, and develop a team of AI engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and rapid, continuous learning. Provide technical guidance and oversight on all projects.
Govern & Standardize: Establish, implement, and enforce AI governance frameworks and MLOps best practices to ensure ethical, responsible, and compliant AI implementations across the organization.
Hands-On Leadership: Remain hands-on in development, guiding the implementation of advanced machine learning, deep learning, and Generative AI models and setting the standard for code quality.
Drive Innovation: Champion research into emerging AI technologies, tools, and methodologies. Drive proof-of-concept initiatives and make strategic recommendations for integrating cutting-edge solutions.
Oversee MLOps: Define and lead the strategy for MLOps, including the robust deployment, monitoring, and full lifecycle management of AI applications in containerized environments like OpenShift.
Required Skills and Qualifications
6+ years of experience in Gen AI application development, building and deploying solutions with large language models such as GPT, Gemini, Claude, and Llama.
Leadership & Management: Proven experience in a technical leadership or team management role, with a strong ability to mentor engineers, manage project priorities, and drive team performance.
Architectural Expertise: Demonstrated ability to design and architect scalable, high-availability, end-to-end AI and machine learning systems.
Business Acumen: Significant experience collaborating with non-technical business stakeholders to identify opportunities, define requirements, and articulate a clear AI strategy.
AI Governance: Strong understanding and practical experience in implementing governance, risk, and ethical guidelines for enterprise-grade AI solutions.
Expert Python Proficiency: Expert-level programming skills in Python and its core AI/ML ecosystem (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn).
Deep AI/ML Expertise: Extensive, hands-on implementation experience with Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI systems.
Advanced Data Expertise: Proven expertise in designing and managing complex data handling, preprocessing, and validation pipelines for mission-critical AI applications.
Advanced MLOps: Deep, practical experience in MLOps, including containerization (Docker), orchestration (OpenShift/Kubernetes), CI/CD, and production deployment of AI models.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
Core Technical Stack & Expertise
The ideal candidate will have deep, hands-on expertise and strategic experience with the following technologies:
LLMs: Gemini, OpenAI models (GPT series), Copilot, Claude, Llama, and experience with Local Models.
Frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, Datasets, Tokenizers).
Orchestration: LangGraph and designing and building complex Multi-Agent Systems.
Development: Building production-grade, scalable services using Python, FastAPI, and asynchronous programming patterns.
RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation): Designing and implementing advanced retrieval techniques using Vector DBs (e.g., Pinecone, Chroma) and PostgreSQL (with pgvector).
ML/DL Platforms: PyTorch and/or TensorFlow for building and fine-tuning models at scale.
Deployment & Monitoring: Containerization with Docker, deploying resilient production APIs, and implementing comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting strategies.
Applied AI Skills: Mastery of Advanced Prompt Engineering, AI Workflow Design, and GenAI application optimization for cost, latency, and performance.
The Ideal Candidate
You are a strategic thinker and a master builder , capable of seeing the long-term vision and diving deep into the technical details to make it a reality.
You are an experienced and empathetic leader who empowers your team to do their best work.
You excel at bridging the gap between business and technology , translating complex problems into actionable and impactful AI strategies.
You have a deep-seated commitment to building responsible AI and establishing robust governance.
You are a thought leader and lifelong learner , staying at the absolute cutting edge of the AI industry and inspiring others to do the same.
You have a proven track record of delivering high-impact AI solutions from initial concept to full-scale production.

The Vice President (VP) / Senior Software Engineer – Technical Remediation & Enablement Lead is a hands-on, code-level technical specialist responsible for driving the direct remediation of software vulnerabilities across enterprise application teams. This individual contributor / team-level technical lead works alongside application developers and contractor engineers to fix static code vulnerabilities (SAST), patch vulnerable software dependencies (SCA/third-party libraries), containerize workloads, and streamline local build/release pipelines to achieve same-day vulnerability hotfix and deployment capabilities .
This role combines active software engineering (writing/refactoring code and debugging pipelines) with technical enablement, guiding squad developers on how to adopt internal security and build tools, resolve tricky dependency conflicts, and package applications into modern containers for rapid, low-risk production releases.
Key Responsibilities & Core Duties
1. Hands-On Code Remediation & Dependency Patching
Write, refactor, and review application code to directly remediate static code analysis (SAST) findings (e.g., SQL/command injection, cross-site scripting, insecure deserialization, improper error handling, weak cryptography).
Resolve complex third-party library and framework upgrades (SCA/CVE remediation), managing transitive dependency conflicts, breaking API changes, and version incompatibilities across Java, Python, Go, .NET, or JavaScript/TypeScript stacks.
Implement targeted automated unit, integration, and regression tests to validate that code fixes and patched libraries do not introduce functional regressions.
2. Containerization & Same-Day Release Enablement
Work directly in application repositories to write and optimize Dockerfile s, container manifests, and base image configurations (Docker, OCI, Kubernetes/OpenShift).
Assist application squads in containerizing non-containerized legacy services, establishing minimal base images and automated base-image rebuild triggers for same-day OS/runtime patching.
Help configure and fine-tune CI/CD build scripts and release pipelines to compress deployment cycle times and eliminate manual deployment steps for emergency hotfixes.
3. Application Plan Technical Validation
Perform code-level reviews of proposed remediation plans from application teams, verifying whether proposed library version bumps or refactored logic effectively eliminate the root cause of the vulnerability.
Identify technical prerequisites (e.g., test coverage gaps, build tool upgrades, compiler/runtime updates) needed before a team can successfully patch and release.
4. Contractor Squad Pairing & PR Review
Act as a peer reviewer and technical guide for external contractor engineers assigned to assist with remediation work.
Review contractor-submitted pull requests (PRs) for code cleanliness, security correctness, test coverage, and enterprise architectural standards.
Facilitate smooth technical onboarding and repository access for contractor developers.
5. Internal Tooling Adoption & Developer Feedback
Actively pilot, adopt, and demonstrate internal developer tools, IDE security plugins, automated PR bots (e.g., Dependabot/Renovate patterns), and local scanning utilities within engineering squads.
Troubleshoot false positives, scanner configuration errors, and build pipeline failures; provide direct, actionable feedback to internal platform and tooling teams to improve developer experience.
Required Qualifications & Experience
Education & Experience Requirements
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical field.
4–7 years of hands-on software development and engineering experience delivering enterprise web applications, microservices, or distributed backend systems.
Proven track record of directly fixing static code vulnerabilities (SAST) and managing third-party dependency/package upgrades in production environments.
Practical, hands-on experience containerizing applications and working with container orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift).
Technical Proficiencies
Core Programming Languages: Strong, hands-on development proficiency in at least one or two primary enterprise languages: Java (Spring Boot), Python, Go, C#/.NET, or TypeScript/Node.js .
Static Code Analysis (SAST): Ability to analyze and fix scanner findings from tools such as SonarQube, Checkmarx, Veracode, or Fortify .
Dependency & Package Management: Practical experience with dependency resolution and build tools: Maven, Gradle, npm/yarn, NuGet, pip/Poetry, or Go modules , alongside SCA tools like Snyk, Black Duck, or JFrog Xray .
Containers & Runtime: Hands-on experience creating production-grade Dockerfile s, managing multi-stage builds, patching container base images, and deploying to Kubernetes or OpenShift .
CI/CD & Version Control: Proficient with Git , branching strategies (Gitflow/trunk-based), and pipeline configurations (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Tekton, GitLab CI, Harness).
Core Competencies & Working Style
Competency
Behavioral Expectation
Hands-On Craftsmanship
Loves writing code, debugging builds, untangling messy dependency trees, and seeing clean PRs merged to production.
Developer-to-Developer Empathy
Speaks the language of squad engineers, troubleshoots shoulder-to-shoulder, and offers practical solutions rather than abstract advice.
Pragmatic Problem Solver
Able to quickly find safe workarounds or code refactors when direct library upgrades introduce breaking API changes.
Clear Communication
Explains the "why" and "how" of security fixes clearly in PR comments, documentation, and pairing sessions.

Build & Release Optimization: Measurable reduction in build and deployment friction for patched releases within supported application squads.

The Applications Development Intermediate Programmer Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for participation in the establishment and implementation of new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to applications systems analysis and programming activities.
We are seeking an experienced and skilled DevOps Engineer to join our innovation team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the implementation, and maintenance of our cutting-edge Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) platformThis role involves end-to-end ownership of the CI/CD pipeline, deployment environments on OpenShift, and the operational management of our "IDP Studio."
The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer with deep expertise in modern DevOps practices, container orchestration, and observability. You will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of a platform that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) for document processing.
Key Responsibilities
CI/CD Pipeline Ownership:
Design, build, and maintain robust, automated CI/CD pipelines using a combination of Harness , Github , Tekton , and Lightspeed (LSE) .
Ensure seamless integration from code commit to production deployment, focusing on speed, quality, and security.
Manage and optimize the build, test, and release processes for all components of the IDP platform, including Python and React JS applications.
OpenShift Deployments:
Manage and automate deployments of microservices and applications to OpenShift clusters.
Implement and maintain deployment strategies such as blue-green, canary, and rolling updates.
Ensure high availability, scalability, and resilience of applications running on OpenShift.
Database Management:
Oversee the management and maintenance of Postgres databases.
Implement and manage database schema changes using Liquibase .
Helm Chart Lifecycle Management:
Lead the authoring, versioning, and release management of Helm charts for all platform services.
Establish and enforce best practices for Helm chart development to ensure reusability and maintainability.
Manage the lifecycle of charts in our Artifactory repository.
Kafka/Messaging Operations:
Oversee the operational health of our Kafka messaging backbone.
Responsible for topic management, including creation, partitioning, and access control.
Perform consumer group tuning and monitoring to ensure optimal performance and data throughput.
Container Governance and Security:
Implement and manage a strict container governance policy.
Integrate automated image scanning ( Snyk/Checkmarx ) into the CI/CD pipeline to identify vulnerabilities.
Manage the container lifecycle within Artifactory , including promotion, retention, and patching strategies for base and application images.
Observability Stack Build-out:
Architect, build, and maintain a comprehensive observability stack using Prometheus , Grafana , and ELK/Splunk .
Develop dashboards, alerts, and logging solutions to provide deep insights into platform health and performance.
Proactively identify and resolve issues through effective monitoring and root cause analysis.
Required Skills and Experience
Experience: 3+ years in a DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering role.
CI/CD: Proven hands-on experience with at least two of the following: Harness, Tekton, Lightspeed (LSE), and experience with Python and React JS build processes.
Database: Experience with Postgres database management and schema migration using Liquibase .
Containerization: Expert-level knowledge of Docker and container orchestration with Kubernetes and/or OpenShift.
Helm: Demonstrable experience in creating and managing complex Helm charts.
Messaging Systems: Strong operational experience with Kafka, including administration and performance tuning.
Security: Experience with container security scanning tools (e.g., Snyk, Checkmarx) and repository management (e.g., Artifactory).
Observability: Proficiency in setting up and managing monitoring and logging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and the ELK stack or Splunk.
Preferred Qualifications (Good to Have)
GenAI/LLM Exposure: Direct experience building, supporting, or working with platforms that utilize Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Python: Advanced proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, and developing backend services.
Certifications: OpenShift or Kubernetes certifications (e.g., CKA, CKAD, Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration) are a plus.
Industry Experience: Experience working in a highly regulated environment such as finance or government.
Education:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
The client requirement mandates that the candidates should be US Citizens and Green Card Holders.

Do you enjoy collaborating with diverse teams, sharing your knowledge, and helping raise the bar for everyone around you? Do you thrive in a collaborative Agile environment and take pride in seeing the applications you build make users happy? About the Team
Prime Brokerage Technology delivers the solutions that underpin the operations of our clients and traders, forming the technological backbone of our Prime Finance business. This is an area of significant opportunity, identified as a major growth priority for Citi — with technology serving as the key to unlocking that potential.
Overview
Prime Finance operates in a highly competitive marketplace, delivering Prime Brokerage services to institutional clients such as hedge funds, backed by robust financing and stock borrow capabilities.
Prime Brokerage Technology provides the platforms and solutions that support our clients and traders - the foundation of the Prime Brokerage business. Our clients depend on us to deliver consistently high levels of service, ensuring transactions, payments, and reporting are processed accurately and without failure, every single day.
We are partway through a transformation journey - replacing legacy components with test-driven, cloud-native microservices designed for stability, scalability, and release agility
Responsibilities:

Work within an Agile team with a strong focus on Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD)
Actively participate in design, planning, and estimation discussions

Help resolve a variety of technical problems through careful evaluation of business processes, system behavior, and industry standards
Apply and grow your applications programming knowledge, ensuring your work aligns with the overall architecture blueprint
Build understanding of system flow and contribute to coding, testing, debugging, and implementation standards
Develop a broader understanding of how architecture, infrastructure, and other business functions come together to support business goals
Contribute analytical thinking to help define issues clearly and shape practical solutions
Share knowledge and support junior colleagues as you build toward technical leadership

Background delivering software using an iterative Agile approach

Track record of owning and delivering reliable outcomes for business users
Comfortable engaging with product owners to understand requirements and help explore solutions
Ability to manage multiple tasks or projects at once
Prior exposure to Prime Brokerage is a plus but not essential

Open, collaborative communication style
Genuine pride in delivering solutions that make users happy

The Applied AI and Agents Factory brings together ambitious engineers to turn advanced AI capabilities into production-ready solutions. Working directly with business and technology teams, you’ll tackle complex engineering challenges, build intelligent agents and take ideas from initial concept through to live deployment.
This is an opportunity to work at the cutting edge of AI engineering, developing systems that go beyond conversational tools to reason, plan and execute multi-step workflows. You’ll take ownership of the full engineering lifecycle, from agent architecture and orchestration to enterprise integration, security and observability.
With a strong focus on hands-on engineering, collaboration and rapid delivery, the Factory gives you the opportunity to solve challenging technical problems, influence architectural decisions and help shape reusable tools and engineering standards adopted across Citi.
The Forward Deployed Engineer (C12) is an agile, hands-on software engineer embedded within Line of Business pods. This role is responsible for building agent features and prototypes, constructing automated evaluation testbeds, optimizing prompts and data parsers, and automating continuous testing pipelines to guarantee the accuracy, safety, and reliability of production AI agents.
Responsibilities:
Agent Prototyping & Feature Engineering: Develop and iterate on agent features, prompt templates, system instructions, few-shot examples, and data pre-processing scripts under the guidance of senior team members.
Automated Evaluation Testbeds: Build, calibrate, and execute automated evaluation test suites using enterprise evaluation studios and frameworks (measuring agent task completion, tool call correctness, semantic similarity, latency, and hallucination metrics).
Golden Dataset & Benchmark Curation: Curate, version, and maintain domain-specific golden evaluation datasets, synthetic benchmarks, and edge-case regression testbeds in collaboration with Line of Business domain experts.
CI/CD Test Pipeline Automation: Author and maintain automated test execution scripts within enterprise CI/CD pipelines, enforcing continuous evaluation gates prior to staging and production rollout.
Guardrail & Security Verification: Validate and test AI guardrail policies (prompt injection defenses, toxicity filters, PII redaction) across agent input/output pipelines to ensure safe operation.
Telemetry & Diagnostic Reporting: Monitor agent performance metrics, log evaluations, and generate prompt diagnostic reports to assist squad leads and business stakeholders in optimizing agent behavior.
Agile Pod Participation: Operate with increasing autonomy within fast-paced agile squads, actively contributing to sprint planning, standups, and codebase maintenance.
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citi, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Programming Skills: Solid Python, Java, or Go programming proficiency with hands-on experience integrating REST/gRPC APIs, Docker containers, and Git workflows.
AI & Evaluation Literacy: Working knowledge of Generative AI concepts, prompt engineering, and evaluation methodologies (e.g., semantic similarity, LLM-as-a-judge, benchmark test suites).
CI/CD & DevOps Basics: Experience working with automated test pipelines and CI/CD tools (e.g., Tekton, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Harness).
Communication & Collaboration: Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with a methodical, detail-oriented approach to software quality and data integrity.

Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst – Senior Cloud & Risk Platform Engineer
Are you passionate about engineering high-throughput, cloud-native distributed systems that power global financial decisioning? Are you an innovative builder who embraces modern AI-augmented software engineering—leveraging intelligent tools like GitHub Copilot, Claude, and Devin to accelerate the SDLC and solve complex engineering challenges faster?
The Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst is a senior-level position responsible for architecting and building robust, resilient, ultra-low latency, and high-performance services across our next-generation Cloud stack. In this role, you will lead the core systems analysis, design, and implementation of mission-critical services spanning Credit Risk and Market Risk platforms, turning quantitative models and complex risk analytics into scalable, real-time cloud microservices.
Responsibilities:
Architect & Build Cloud-Native Services: Lead the design, development, and deployment of resilient, event-driven microservices and high-throughput computing pipelines on modern cloud infrastructure (Containers, Kubernetes, Microservices).
Power Enterprise Risk Engines: Partner closely with Risk Quantitative Analysts, Risk Managers, and Enterprise Architecture teams to model, calculate, and stream real-time analytics across Credit Risk (PFE, Exposure, Counterparty Risk, Limits) and Market Risk (VaR, Stress Testing, Sensitivity Analysis).
Champion AI-Augmented Engineering: Pioneer the adoption of modern AI engineering toolsets (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Devin ) across the engineering lifecycle—from rapid prototyping and boilerplate reduction to automated unit/integration test synthesis, complex refactoring, and AI-driven code reviews.
Lead System Resiliency & Scalability: Resolve complex architectural bottlenecks through in-depth evaluation of distributed systems, multi-threading, concurrency models, memory management, and enterprise data flows.
Define Engineering Excellence: Establish and champion standards for clean code, SOLID principles, automated CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and comprehensive telemetry/observability.
Technical Mentorship & Thought Leadership: Serve as a technical advisor and coach to mid-level engineers and analysts, conducting design reviews, fostering a culture of continuous learning, and accelerating delivery velocity.
Risk & Controls Governance: Appropriately assess risk when business and technical decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct, and business practices, and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency.
Qualifications:
6–10 years of progressive experience in software engineering, distributed systems development, or applications architecture.
Core Java & Modern Stack Mastery: Deep expertise in Java (Java 17/21+), J2EE, Spring Boot, reactive frameworks, advanced multi-threading, asynchronous I/O, low-latency processing, and memory optimization.
Risk Domain Expertise: Strong working knowledge of Credit Risk and/or Market Risk concepts (e.g., Counterparty Credit Risk, Stress Testing, Exposure Calculations, Value at Risk / VaR, Sensitivities, Scenarios).
Cloud & Distributed Computing: Hands-on experience architecting microservices on cloud platforms, with solid containerization and orchestration expertise ( Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, OpenShift ).
AI Tooling & Modern Dev Acceleration: Demonstrated proficiency and enthusiasm for integrating AI coding assistants and agentic engineering tools ( GitHub Copilot, Claude, Devin, ChatGPT/LLM APIs ) to elevate team velocity, code quality, and automated debugging.
High-Throughput Messaging & Event Streaming: Experience with distributed messaging backbones and streaming platforms such as Apache Kafka , Pulsar, or RabbitMQ.
API & Data Architecture: Strong experience designing robust RESTful APIs, gRPC services, and working with relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MS SQL) and distributed caches/NoSQL platforms (Redis, Hazelcast, Cassandra, MongoDB).
Quality & Test Automation: Proven background with testing frameworks (JUnit 5, Mockito, Cucumber, Testcontainers) and performance benchmarking (JMeter, Gatling).
CI/CD & DevOps: Hands-on familiarity with modern CI/CD automation pipelines (Git, Tekton, Harness, Jenkins), static analysis (SonarQube), and container security scanning.
Leadership & Communication: Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and collaborative skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and risk concepts clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.
Education:
Bachelor’s degree / University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Financial Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. (Master's degree preferred).
